description_for_model: Use this plugin to explore the Agent Cookbook directory. Search and retrieve curated knowledge on modern AI agent tools, Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, vibe coding IDEs (Google Antigravity, Cursor, Windsurf, Devin), multi-agent frameworks (LangGraph, CrewAI), and standardized agent context files (AGENTS.md, llms.txt).
